responsibility: Coordinates the `check` phase’s public queries and shared helpers, wiring providers for destructor, region-scope, impl-item, coroutine, and well-formedness checks while exposing common signature-checking and diagnostic support used across the module.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the nested `check/fn_ctxt/mod.rs` and `check/method/mod.rs`, this `mod.rs` is the top-level coordinator for the broader checking phase: it registers and exposes shared checking infrastructure and queries across item signatures and bodies, while those sibling same-name files handle one body-checking context and one method-resolution subsystem respectively.
